SELECTED_INDEX: 4
CONFIDENCE: 0.68
EXPLANATION: The strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2841 and 2940 cm⁻¹ and CH2/CH3 deformations at 1458 and 1367 cm⁻¹ fit a saturated alkyl framework (GFQ-003). The cluster of medium peaks at 855, 974, 1007, and 1158 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of multiple C–O–C vibrations in dialkyl ethers (typical ether Raman bands in the 850–1150 cm⁻¹ region), which best matches a di-ether like CCOCCC(C)OC. Candidates with N–H or O–H (e.g., 8, 9, 1, 10) would typically show an N–H/O–H stretch near ~3300–3600 cm⁻¹, absent here. The nitro-bearing candidate (5) would be expected to show a strong νₐ(NO₂) near ~1530–1610 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-022), which is not observed; thus 5 is less likely. The 1332 cm⁻¹ band need not indicate diamond (GFQ-061/SPC-008) and can be attributed to alkyl/ether skeletal modes in this context.
